fields.label: Item Operation
fields.description: Copied from the ERPNext BOM Item operation. This determines which Job Card receives the component.

fields.label: Source Warehouse
fields.description: Per-component source used on the Work Order and production Stock Entry.

fields.label: WIP Presentation
fields.options:
Standard ERP / Tag Flow
Standard Quantity Reusable WIP Bin
Loose Multi-Item WIP Bin
fields.description: Standard Quantity uses a visually verified fixed capacity. Loose Multi-Item uses an authorized reusable bin with no fixed capacity and records cumulative use separately.

fields.label: Loose WIP Release Policy
fields.options:
Full Job Card Quantity Before Start
Incremental by Operation Cycle
fields.default: Full Job Card Quantity Before Start
fields.description: Incremental allows each reusable Operation Card cycle to load and report part of the Job Card requirement. Other material rows retain their normal readiness gates.

fields.label: Loose WIP Use Recording
fields.options:
Every Operation Cycle
At Job Card End
fields.depends_on: eval:doc.wip_presentation_method=='Loose Multi-Item WIP Bin' && doc.loose_wip_release_policy=='Incremental by Operation Cycle'
fields.mandatory_depends_on: eval:doc.wip_presentation_method=='Loose Multi-Item WIP Bin' && doc.loose_wip_release_policy=='Incremental by Operation Cycle'
fields.description: Every Operation Cycle requires a use scan before each reusable card closes. At Job Card End allows high-frequency cards to close from ERP progress and records the consolidated actual bin use before ERP consumption.

fields.label: WIP Bin Pool
fields.depends_on: eval:['Standard Quantity Reusable WIP Bin','Loose Multi-Item WIP Bin'].includes(doc.wip_presentation_method)
fields.mandatory_depends_on: eval:['Standard Quantity Reusable WIP Bin','Loose Multi-Item WIP Bin'].includes(doc.wip_presentation_method)

fields.label: Fallback Qty per Full Bin
fields.description: Optional backward-compatible capacity used only when the scanned Handling Unit has no active Item-specific Full-bin Capacity. Leave zero only when every active bin in the selected Pool has this Item configured. This is not the total BOM/ERP row requirement.
